messages:
Jordan (customer): Hey team — after yesterday's rerank model push our top-1 results changed for identical inputs. Samples attached in the ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-4821. This is a blocker for the customer, some queries flip between two answers.
Maya (cs): Sorry about that, Jordan. Do you have the original request payloads and the response JSONs (before vs after)? Even a single minimal repro would help.
Jordan (customer): Pasting minimal example below. Request id old: req-2098, new: req-5032. Same query, same candidates.
--- request payload ---
POST /v1/rerank HTTP/1.1
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "model": "r-rerank-v2q",
  "query": "best noise cancelling headphones for flights",
  "candidates": ["Option A", "Option B", "Option C"],
  "top_k": 1
}
--- old response ---
[{"candidate":"Option A","score":0.812}]
--- new response ---
[{"candidate":"Option B","score":0.789}]
Jordan (customer): Note: we run with the same encoded candidates array, no trimming. No rate limiting errors.
Maya (cs): Thanks. Samir / Jun, can you take a look? This smells like a scoring drift after the v2q rollout.
Samir (eng-ml): I saw the deploy logs — we rolled r-rerank-v2q to prod at 2026-03-09 03:14 UTC, incident-bot posted: "deployed r-rerank-v2q to cluster-prod-a".
incident-bot: deploy: r-rerank-v2q -> cluster-prod-a at 2026-03-09T03:14:02Z :rocket:
Olivia (eng-platform): Quick checklist: input canonicalization changed recently? Any JSON->string normalization path we changed in the routing layer? Also check truncation: if total token length > model max we had a change that silently truncates tails.
Jun (eng-ml): Two hypotheses: (1) tokenization shift — v2q uses different byte-pair merges causing borderline token differences and thus different logits; (2) quantization/kernel selection changed numerical rounding on longer contexts. Both can flip near-equal candidates.
Samir (eng-ml): Repro steps I used: curl example -> compute scores locally against offline model snapshot. I can run a batch of the customer's payloads through both v2 and v2q.
Samir (eng-ml): Small repro command I ran:
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"r-rerank-v2q","query":"best noise cancelling headphones for flights","candidates":["Option A","Option B","Option C"]}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank | jq .
```
Samir (eng-ml): Locally v2 (snapshot 2026-03-08) returns Option A 0.812, v2q (prod) returns Option B 0.789. Scores differ in 0.01-0.03 band for many examples.
Maya (cs): Can we show the raw logits or normalized scores for debugging? Customer wants an explanation before they decide to pin back.
Jun (eng-ml): Yes — I can dump logits for the three candidates. Quick sample:
old logits: [2.34, 1.98, 0.45] -> softmax -> [0.58,0.35,0.07]
new logits: [2.05, 2.10, 0.48] -> softmax -> [0.34,0.42,0.24]  <-- tiny difference in logits flips top-1.
Olivia (eng-platform): This aligns with a tokenization/embedding quant shift. Action items: (A) eng-ml to run parity tests over the customer's 1000 queries and produce a delta histogram, (B) cs to offer customer a rollback window or pin to r-rerank-v2 for 48h, (C) eng-platform to check whether any request normalization changed in the router layer during the rollout.
Maya (cs): Jordan — we can pin your workspace to r-rerank-v2 immediately while we investigate. Would you like that? :+1:
Jordan (customer): Yes please pin to v2 for now. Appreciate quick turnaround.
Samir (eng-ml): I'll run the parity batch and post a summary (false positive flips, magnitude histogram, tokenization diffs) by EOD UTC.
Jun (eng-ml): If parity shows systematic bias we can do: revert rollout, or tighten the quantization config and re-run canary.
Maya (cs): Logging this as CS-4821. I'll update the customer with pin and ETA.
Jordan (customer): Thanks all, will wait for the report.
Samir (eng-ml): Initial parity batch results: 6.3% of queries flipped top-1, median score delta 0.018. Attaching sample diffs.
Olivia (eng-platform): I found one router change PR that strips trailing newlines for text inputs in JSON path. PR #5123 merged 2026-03-08 — could affect token boundaries.
Jun (eng-ml): Good find. That could change tokenization for short queries — can you revert or add a flag?
Olivia (eng-platform): I'll open a hotfix and a feature flag to preserve original whitespace for rerank endpoints.
Maya (cs): Customer pinned, they confirmed pin succeeded. Jordan, let us know if you see any more flips after pin.
Jordan (customer): Pin confirmed, thanks. Please keep us posted and include the parity report.
Samir (eng-ml): Report posted in ticket CS-4821 with CSV and histogram links. Next steps: run extended parity across top customers, consider adjusting quant config and re-canary.
Maya (cs): Closing interim loop with customer. Leaving thread open for follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
